item.title: [IGNITE-10022] JS, PHP thin clients: a more meaningful exception when ENUM type is not registered
item.description: NodeJS and PHP thin clients should throw a more meaningful exception for put/get ENUM type data in case the ENUM type is not registered.
item.summary: JS, PHP thin clients: a more meaningful exception when ENUM type is not registered

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.
